items.claim: Mackenzie lacks open-mat takedowns and often has to pull guard.
items.quote: she does lack open-mat takedowns. That's why I said a lot of the time she's just pulling guard

items.claim: Gillian might be the better striker and could win on the feet against Mackenzie.
items.quote: I think like somehow I think Gillian might be the better striker and could win on the feet.

items.claim: Mackenzie was able to control Virna Jandiroba on the mat twice.
items.quote: Mackenzie's done it twice, so you can't even be like, 'Oh, it was an off night.' She's done that twice.

items.claim: Ian Machado Garry is one of the more accurate strikers in the division with good combinations.
items.quote: solid striker. I would say that he's probably one of the more accurate guys in the division. He's got He's got good combinations

items.claim: Ian Garry sometimes backs up with his chin down, though he recovers extremely fast.
items.quote: he'll back up with his chin down. It hasn't cost him though because he's durable and he recovers extremely fast.

items.claim: Ian Garry has great takedown defense and opponents rarely control him on the ground.
items.quote: He's got great takedown defense. Very few people have been able to take him down and when they have, it's even less likely they control him.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev forces inactivity out of his opponents by mixing striking and takedown feints.
items.quote: he has a good mix of both striking and takedown faints. And when he when he uses those, he forces inactivity out of his opponents.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is the best grappler in the UFC.
items.quote: He is an excellent grappler. In fact, I think he's the best grappler in the UFC.
